**Step: To select the best performing value of the regularization hyperparameter via 8-fold CV, how many times must each data point be used as part of a held-out validation fold?**

**Hint 1:** In an 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. For each fold, one part is used as the validation set, and the remaining $$7$$ parts are used as the training set. Each data point will be part of the validation set exactly once for each value of the hyperparameter.

**Hint 2:** Since there are $$11$$ different values of the hyperparameter being tested, each data point will be part of the validation set once for each of these $$11$$ values. Therefore, consider how many times each data point is used as a validation point across all hyperparameter values.
